The**Ministry of Culture**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Πολιτισμού) is the[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece)entrusted with preserving the country's[cultural heritage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Culture_of_Greece)and promoting[the arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_arts). The incumbent minister is[Lina Mendoni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lina_Mendoni), and the deputy minister is[Iason Fotilas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iason_Fotilas?action=edit&redlink=1)[[el](https://el.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CE%99%CE%AC%CF%83%CF%89%CE%BD%20%CE%A6%CF%89%CF%84%CE%AE%CE%BB%CE%B1%CF%82)].
